description: Rules 3, 5.2, 5.3, and 6 of spec/rules.md. Section 'cases': the good-until date of one batch and its source, with the days left and the freshness for 'today'. The product gives the food, and 'storageKind' is the storage kind of the storage area of the batch. A batch with no 'frozenDate' key or no 'thawedDate' key has no such date. Section 'order': the use-first order of the batches of an inventory. Section 'plan': the plan of a use. The table of foods here is a small sample. It is not spec/foods.json.

a batch from before the opened date has no openedDate key
the after-opening date is earlier than the expiry date
the after-opening date is later than the expiry date
the two dates are the same: the expiry date and its source
the after-opening date is one day earlier than the expiry date
no expiry date, and an opened date
no expiry date, and no opened days for the storage kind
an expiry date, and no opened days for the storage kind
the opened days of the pantry
the opened days of the fridge for the same food
a product with no food
a food that is not in the table
a food with no opened days
an estimated date, and an earlier after-opening date
a chosen date, and an earlier after-opening date
a use-by date, and an earlier after-opening date
the opened date is before the date added
the opened date is after the expiry date
the after-opening date is before today
the after-opening date is 3 days from today
the after-opening date is after year 9999: there is none

a frozen batch with no expiry date

a frozen batch of a food that is not in the table has the default freezer days

an opened batch with no expiry date comes before a batch with no good-until date
